name: Zenith Banking
description: Next-generation digital banking platform with real-time transactions and AI-driven insights.
full_description: Zenith Banking is a full-stack fintech platform designed for modern consumers who need visibility and control over their finances. Built with Next.js App Router and Supabase, it provides real-time account balances, transaction history, AI-powered spending analysis, and multi-currency support. The UI is crafted with premium design principles to elevate trust and reduce cognitive load for users.
bullets: Real-time transaction processing with optimistic UI updates
AI spending categorization using OpenAI API
Multi-currency support with live exchange rates
End-to-end Stripe payment integration
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliant

name: Nebula AI Platform
description: AI-powered content generation SaaS — text, images, and code in one workspace.
full_description: Nebula is a multi-modal AI SaaS application enabling creators, marketers, and developers to generate high-quality content at scale. Powered by GPT-4 and Stable Diffusion, it offers a unified workspace for writing, image synthesis, and code completion. The platform features team collaboration, version history, usage analytics, and a credit-based billing model integrated with Stripe.
bullets: Multi-modal AI: text, images, and code generation
Team workspaces with role-based access control
Real-time collaboration on documents
Usage analytics dashboard for admins
Stripe subscription and credit billing

name: Aether Social
description: Decentralized social network with on-chain identity and creator monetization.
full_description: Aether Social is a Web3-native social platform that gives users full ownership of their identity and content via Ethereum-based smart contracts. Creators can gate premium posts behind token requirements, receive direct crypto tips, and grow verified on-chain audiences. The mobile apps are built in React Native with a vibrant, expressive UI system inspired by Farcaster and Lens Protocol.
bullets: On-chain identity via ENS & user-controlled wallets
Creator monetization: token-gated posts and NFT tips
Decentralized content storage on IPFS
Cross-platform: iOS, Android, and web PWA
Gas-optimized Solidity smart contracts

name: Catalyst CRM
description: Lightweight CRM built for growing agencies — pipelines, contacts, and email automation.
full_description: Catalyst CRM is a modern sales pipeline and customer relationship management tool designed specifically for small-to-mid agencies. It features drag-and-drop Kanban pipelines, automated follow-up email sequences, client health scoring, and a live dashboard with conversion metrics. The backend is entirely Supabase with real-time subscriptions powering the live board updates.
bullets: Drag-and-drop Kanban sales pipeline
Automated email sequences via Resend
Client health score based on activity signals
Real-time board updates with Supabase subscriptions
CSV import/export for bulk contact management

name: Momentum Fitness
description: AI-powered personal trainer app that adapts workouts to your progress and goals.
full_description: Momentum is a cross-platform fitness application that uses machine learning to create personalized workout plans. It adapts training intensity, rest periods, and exercise selection based on user performance data captured after each session. The app integrates with Apple Health and Google Fit for biometric data, and features a gamified progression system to maximize user retention.
bullets: AI workout personalization using on-device TensorFlow Lite
Apple Health and Google Fit biometric sync
Gamified streak and achievement system
Video exercise demonstrations with rep counting
Social challenges and leaderboards
